text:
Ravi Kumar: Heads-up - Nova Labs signed SOW but asking for 50% off first 60 days + removal of overage fees. Need deal desk ok.

Tasha Brown: Account is midmarket; estimated usage 30M tokens/mo during pilot. Sales says potential to scale to dedicated next year.

Will Harper: Finance policy: pilot discounts >40% need VP-Finance approval. Overage fee removal increases revenue exposure. Can we limit exposure with a capped credit?

Ravi Kumar: Sales counter: willing to accept capped credit up to $5k instead of full fee waiver, but prefers % discount if possible to keep contract simple.

Will Harper: Proposed structure:
```
Item: Pilot (30M tokens/mo) - list $3,000/mo
Requested: 50% off month 1-2 + waive overage fees (months 1-2)
Finance counter: 40% off months 1-2 + $5k one-time overage credit, billing Net30. Require credit check and signed PO for Net30/Net60 consideration.
```

revs-bot: Approval ticket APP-5023 opened and routed to Will Harper + VP-Finance. Link: https://internal/approvals/APP-5023

Tasha Brown: Sales can accept 40% + $5k credit to close. Will request PO and confirm intent to scale. Holding signature until APP-5023 decision.

Will Harper: I'll review credit risk and route to VP-Finance. If credit check fails, require prepay or revert to standard overage terms.

Ravi Kumar: Thanks everyone — updating SOW to reflect finance counter and noting pending approval.
